Guides / decision communication

How to Ask for a Decision

Decision requests work when the reader knows the exact choice and the cost of waiting.

A practical method

Name the decision, deadline, options, and your recommendation. Put supporting detail below those four facts.

Example

“Please choose the launch date by Tuesday: May 4 or May 11. I recommend May 11 because testing needs four more days.”

What to avoid

Do not end with a vague “thoughts?” when approval is actually required.

Try this

Rewrite one pending message so its first sentence states the needed decision and date.

Related learning

Continue with the free Learning Hub. For a fuller treatment, The Art of Being Heard may be relevant.
